label: Meshy
description: Meshy AI API — Discover free community models first, then text/image-to-3D, remesh/retexture/convert/resize, auto-rig, animate. Import into Blender or UEFN Content Browser.

settings.sections.title: Meshy
settings.sections.description: Paste your Meshy API key (from meshy.ai → Settings → API). Stored encrypted on this device. Powers meshy_* MCP tools for generate, remesh/retexture/convert, rig, animate, and import to Blender/UEFN.

properties.label: API key
properties.description: Get a key at https://www.meshy.ai/settings/api — required for meshy_* tools (Pro+). Use Test to verify the key against Meshy.

steps.title: Paste your API key
steps.body: Create a key at meshy.ai → Settings → API (msy_…), paste it here, then hit Test. Tools appear as meshy_* once this plugin is enabled. Do not run npx skills add meshy-dev/meshy-3d-agent — this plugin already ships the skill + MCP tools.

steps.title: Generate, rig, import
steps.body: Agent checks Meshy Discover for FREE community models first (links in chat). Paid generate always asks via a panel question (ducky_ask_user) before confirm_spend. Land with meshy_import_to_uefn or meshy_import_to_blender. Characters: meshy_rig / animate → Blender skeletal_export.
